description: This Java class, `ImagesController`, is a Spring MVC controller that handles HTTP requests related to image retrieval. It serves static images like logos, content images, and product images based on URL patterns, utilizing content and product image services to fetch image data.

classes.name: ImagesController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller class that maps URL requests to methods for retrieving images such as logos, content images, and product images.

methods.name: printImage
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve static images based on URL parameters. It determines the image type, fetches the image content via services, and returns the image bytes.
